description:
Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust

Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
What's Changed
- Ignore leading byte order mark in SRT parser by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3781
- Read sub-dollar amounts without a zero major unit in TTS by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3783
- i18n(sv): translate 49 new strings by @kler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3784
- Reject zero, negative and non-finite FPS in ALE import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3790
- Refuse non-finite curve coordinates in effects.setParam by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3792
- Play/Stop once per Space press, not on key repeat by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3795
- Timeline: the playhead glides during playback instead of jumping a frame at a time by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3806
- Export: the time left counts down between batches; the status bar shows it once a second, in place by @kler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3816
- Clamp negative EDL dissolve/wipe durations to 0 on import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3827
- Handle sub-two 3D LUT sizes by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3839
- fix(ui): a project file dropped on the window opens it (#3843) by @mpratsaki in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3854
- fix(ui): the Project panel's Zoom sizes List thumbnails and the Freeform canvas (#3774) by @mpratsaki in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3871
- Serialize bridge render_frame calls so parallel requests get their own frame (#3837) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3872
- Effect Controls: double-clicking a property's name resets it by @infinityespi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3735
- text: count trailing spaces at a hard line end into the alignment width by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3743
- ui: say where the project was saved in the status bar by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3744
- effects: give 4-Color Gradient a position for each colour by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3747
- Focus the Source monitor when a clip is opened in it (#3669) by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3749
- Bokeh Blur: gather through a kernel of whole-pixel weights, 5x faster on the GPU by @kler in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3768
- History: each step shows the icon of the tool or command that made it by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3776
- fix(graphics): Style buttons show and toggle the Type-tool selection by @alexanderalber in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3673
- G13: TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts export presets by @mpratsaki in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3721
- dng: bound lossless-JPEG decoding by the data it has and reject shared tile bytes by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3680
- Luma Key: key out brights by @marshiyar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3688
- Apply background mask tracking in headless sessions by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3303
- Parse AVI stream numbers as decimal by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3603
- ui: media browser test re-maximizes after Shift+O opens Source by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3897
- engine: mask discard test checks the cancel flag, not the worker's timing by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3899
- fix(ui): Save Arrangement refuses an unknown bin (#3774 follow-up) by @mpratsaki in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3900
- cli: --save runs on one project take turns, so no edit is lost by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3926
- Read decades like 1990s as plural years in TTS normalizer by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3930
New Contributors
- @mpratsaki made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3854
- @infinityespi made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3735
- @JonRC made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3926
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0
